p: which came in and went out: Who executed their charge and office, which is meant by coming in and going out.
over the tribes of Israel: Meaning besides those twelve captains.
half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead: Which is beyond Jordan in respect to Judah, also one captain was over the Reubenites and the Gadites.
because there fell wrath for it: The commandment of the king was abominable to Joab, 1Ch 21:6.
chronicles of king David: The Hebrews make both these books of Chronicles but one, and at this verse make the middle of the book concerning the number of verses.
scribe: That is, a man learned in the word of God.
sons: To be their schoolmasters and teachers.
after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son: After Ahithophel hanged himself, 2Sa 17:23, Jehoiada was made counsellor.
